notes: The 736 average is labeled GMAT (10th edition) in P&Q's Class of 2027 coverage (14% of the class submitted it); 670 is the GMAT Focus average (39% submitted). Acceptance rate and work experience were not seen in authoritative snippets and are nulled. Acceptance rate is not published on the class profile page. GMAT and GRE figures are from the Class of 2027 visual chart; the page also carries a screen-reader-only summary table with different values (73 percent GMAT average 729, median 730; GRE Q 164, V 163) that appears to be an outdated accessibility table inconsistent with the labeled Class of 2027 chart; the chart values are reported here. Test score percentages do not total 100 due to alternate testing requirements for UChicago-affiliated and joint degree applicants. Tuition already sourced to chicagobooth.edu in current data and was not re-verified this session.
